data_fields.name: table_total_mass
data_fields.donor_constant: 1; the leftover mass means nothing spawns; festival rule passes no total (normalised)

data_fields.name: once_per_run_cap
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 per entry per game; a repeat pick is voided, not rerolled

best_idea: Give each zone a weighted spawn table whose leftover mass means nothing spawns, and lock each entry to once per run so that a repeat roll is voided rather than rerolled.
decision_why: Frankendom needs a zone population rule with a per-run cap, and a table with explicit empty mass is a cheap, checkable designer knob. Adapt rather than copy: the donor's void-on-repeat lowers the real rate through a run, so Frankendom must publish the effective per-run rate or reroll on purpose.
acceptance: Server test: for a zone table whose entries sum to 0.475, 10,000 seeded rolls give an entry on 47.5 percent of rolls (within 1 point) and none on the rest; after entry X has spawned once, every later roll that picks X returns none, and the run's spawn list holds X once.
